scripts.lint: ls-lint && biome check . && oxlint . && rumdl check .
scripts.build: bun build packages/swagger-parse/src/swagger-parse.ts --outdir packages/swagger-parse/esm --entry-naming "[name].esm.js" --format esm --target node --packages=external --sourcemap=linked && bun build packages/swagger-parse/src/swagger-parse.ts --outdir packages/swagger-parse/cjs --entry-naming "[name].cjs.js" --format cjs --target node --packages=external --sourcemap=linked && bun run typecheck
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run build
